items.exampleEn: He hung his wet overcoat by the door.
items.exampleZh: 他把濕掉的大衣掛在門邊。

items.exampleEn: We watched the twinkle of the stars from the roof.
items.exampleZh: 我們在屋頂上看星星閃爍。

items.exampleEn: The students used old boxes creatively to build a robot.
items.exampleZh: 學生們很有創意地用舊箱子做了一個機器人。

items.exampleEn: I felt a sharp prick when I touched the rose.
items.exampleZh: 我碰到玫瑰時，感到一陣刺痛。

items.exampleEn: In my haste, I left my keys on the bus.
items.exampleZh: 我一匆忙，把鑰匙忘在公車上了。

items.exampleEn: Waiters bustled around the busy restaurant.
items.exampleZh: 服務生在忙碌的餐廳裡來回奔走。

items.exampleEn: The children tiptoed into the room to surprise their mother.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們踮著腳走進房間，想給媽媽一個驚喜。

items.exampleEn: Children outgrow their shoes very quickly.
items.exampleZh: 小孩的鞋子很快就穿不下了。
items.glossZh: 長大而穿不下；長大後不再…

items.sentenceEn: The dancer tiptoed slowly across the stage.
items.sentenceZh: 舞者踮著腳慢慢走過舞臺。

items.audioEn: I've outgrown this overcoat, so I'm giving it to my younger cousin.
items.audioZh: 我長大了，這件大衣穿不下，所以要送給年紀比我小的表親。
items.questionZh: 說話者打算怎麼處理這件大衣？
options: Give it to a younger relative
Wear the overcoat again next winter
Sell it to an older cousin

items.sentenceEn: She decorated the cake creatively with fresh fruit.
items.sentenceZh: 她用新鮮水果很有創意地裝飾蛋糕。

items.sentenceEn: The twinkle of the city lights made the night feel warm.
items.sentenceZh: 城市燈火閃爍，讓夜晚感覺很溫暖。

items.stemEn: Don't do your homework in ____; check every answer carefully.
items.stemZh: 寫作業別匆匆忙忙的，每個答案都要仔細檢查。

items.stemEn: Most people ____ their fear of the dark as they get older.
items.stemZh: 大多數人長大後就不再怕黑了。

items.passageEn: My daughter needed a costume for her school play, but she had outgrown last year's. With only two days left, I made a new one from my old overcoat. Working in such haste, I got a sharp prick from the needle more than once. On the night of the show, after weeks of rehearsal, parents bustled around the hall looking for seats. When my daughter walked on stage, I saw a twinkle of pride in her eyes.
items.passageZh: 我女兒的學校話劇需要戲服，但她已經穿不下去年那套了。只剩兩天，我就用自己的舊大衣做了一套新的。趕工的時候，我不只一次被針刺到。演出當晚，在好幾個星期的排練之後，家長們在禮堂裡忙著找座位。女兒走上舞臺時，我看到她眼中閃著驕傲的光芒。

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼要做新戲服？
演出那天晚上，作者看到了什麼？
options: 女兒眼中閃著驕傲的光芒

items.promptZh: 老師要我們用有創意的方式解決這個問題。
referenceEn: Our teacher asked us to solve this problem creatively.
The teacher wanted us to think creatively to solve the problem.
rubricZh: 要用 creatively（例如 solve it creatively、think creatively）
「要我們…」可寫，例如 asked us to、wanted us to 等

items.promptZh: 為了不吵醒家人，他半夜踮著腳走下樓。
referenceEn: He tiptoed down the stairs at midnight so he wouldn't wake his family.
At midnight, he tiptoed downstairs to avoid waking his family.
rubricZh: tiptoe 當動詞，後接方向（例如 tiptoed down the stairs、tiptoed downstairs 等）
「為了不吵醒」可寫，例如 so he wouldn't wake、to avoid waking 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 tiptoed、tiptoes 等）
